<div class="card-body">
'''Direct Hit''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used or Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">直撃</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦闘用ビークルを目標として起動している場合に、武器運命数にＸを加える。実際に武器運命数を引く前に使用すること。

ユーズド：Ｘ＝１。
ロスト：Ｘ＝３。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Direct-Hit-PSA-149261359.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">スノースピーダーは高速で移動するため、ＡＴ－ＡＴのレーザー砲では追尾できない。しかし無謀な角度で接近した場合には、熟練したＡＴ－ＡＴの砲手に捕らえられてしまう。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Direct hit.

'''Card text:'''
When firing at a combat vehicle, add X to weapon destiny. Use before the weapon destiny is drawn.

USED: X = 1.
LOST: X = 3.

'''Lore:'''
Snowspeeders move too fast for an AT-AT laser cannon to track. Approaching at a reckless angle lets a skilled AT-AT gunner catch them.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Direct Hit]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
